detail: Advisory GHSA-wq5f-xc86-pv6w: 'sharp : Vulnerability in librsvg dependency CVE-2026-96889', severity high, vulnerable range < 0.35.5, first patched 0.35.5, published by the package's maintainer on 2026-09-30T19:22:51Z (api.github.com/repos/lovell/sharp/security-advisories/GHSA-wq5f-xc86-pv6w) and entered in GitHub's advisory database on 2026-10-06T13:43:57Z, which is when npm audit began to report it (the pull-request runs that finished before then were green). apps/web/package-lock.json locks sharp 0.35.4 as an optional dependency of next 15.5.24 (range ^0.34.3 || ^0.35.3), held by the exact override in apps/web/package.json. Registry facts read by the orchestrator on 2026-10-06 at 15:21 UTC from registry.npmjs.org: sharp 0.35.5 published 2026-09-27T13:46:24.509Z; its 16 @img/sharp-* platform packages at 0.35.5 (15 named by sharp 0.35.5 and @img/sharp-wasm32, a dependency of two of them) published 2026-09-27 between 13:45:21Z and 13:47:45Z; its 10 @img/sharp-libvips-* packages at 1.3.4 published 2026-09-27 between 12:10:37Z and 12:11:24Z; every one more than 604800 seconds old at that reading (the youngest 783261 s). Its other dependencies (semver ^7.8.5, @img/colour ^1.1.0, detect-libc ^2.1.2) are unchanged from 0.35.4. No package name is new to the lock. So the repair needs no exception: CLAUDE.md principle 15 is met by an exact pin to 0.35.5 and a lock regenerated and proven by the generate-lockfile workflow.
needs: Through the dependency-security process: move the sharp override to exactly 0.35.5, regenerate and prove the lock through .github/workflows/generate-lockfile.yml (never locally), a security review of the change (gate G5), a green web-dependency-security run.
Then a fresh green run on each waiting pull request before it merges.
workaround_in_effect: None. No waiver exists; nothing merges with a red check or on a run that predates the advisory.
candidate_followup: Ledger task for the repair, contracted in the same commit as this record; this blocker is resolved at that task's merge with the green run ids as evidence.

history_note: Found on 2026-10-06 at about 15:14 UTC: the integration run after pull request 431 merged failed this one check. Its state was read before anything else; nothing was rerun. resolution.summary: Resolved by the fixed version under the normal dependency policy; no waiver and no exception. The ledger task contracted with this record (ACCEPTED) moved the sharp override to exactly 0.35.5. The lock was regenerated and validated by the generate-lockfile workflow and committed by the workflow itself; only sharp and its 26 platform packages moved (397 entries before and after, none added or removed); npm audit reports 0 at every severity; every moved package was more than 604800 s old. Gates G0/G2/G3/G4/G5 PASS (G3/G4 independent code-reviewer, G5 independent security-reviewer; agent reviews, not human reviews); directive check PASS for D-009-R017. Resolved at 16:57 UTC, when the integration branch's own run after the merge had completed with every job a success.
